Hi Arielle / Lumenix AP team —

Following up on Invoice #9251 for $42,760 (due 08/18/2029). We got a decline when attempting the card on file yesterday; payment did not settle and the balance is still outstanding. I pulled the authorization trace and it looks like the card issuer rejected for limit/merchant-type.

Options to move this along today:
- Wire to our bank (details below) — fastest, guaranteed finality. If you go this route, please reply with the PO number you want on the remittance and the expected send time so I can watch for the incoming.
- Virtual card (one-time) — we can invoice via our virtual card flow; I can send a secure link and it charges immediately (recommended if your AP can accept card payments).
- ACH — if you prefer ACH, please complete the attached ACH authorization and return; ACH will take 2 business days.

Bank (wire) — Redwood Inference LLC
Bank: Northern Pacific Bank
Acct (last 4): 7842
Wire routing: 122000021

I'm attaching the invoice and the ACH authorization form for convenience. If neither wire nor ACH works, we can discuss a short escrow pre-auth while your procurement team sorts card limits.

Next steps: can you confirm preferred route and an ETA today? If you plan to wire, include the expected value date and a reference (PO or invoice number).

Thanks —
Ben

DocuSign link: https://na1.redwood-inference.com/remit/escrow/DL-8742

- if virtual card: name of AP contact who will click the link

Appreciate it —
